appliesTo: Existing assisted-order wizard; Doc99 successor 3a03ad650d16442b622796fd614d6dcf47384ea2 and any separately identified narrow correction
attemptLifetime: The idempotency key and frozen acceptedAt belong to this browser tab's unexpired Early Access session. Draft storage can preserve them across a refresh or retry within that session. They are not a cross-session, cross-tab, cross-device or account recovery mechanism.
privacyBoundary: Session expiry, sign-out and re-unlock retain the existing protected-path storage sweep. Closing a tab ends its sessionStorage lifetime. A rebuilt request can therefore receive a new key. No privacy or authentication exception is introduced to preserve the draft.
uncertainOutcome: A pending or interrupted POST may have persisted even when the browser did not receive a receipt. A later validation, drift or authorization refusal does not establish that an earlier uncertain attempt was never saved. Do not advise creating a new request merely to obtain a response.

staffDuplicateCheck.owner: Existing authorized staffed ordering operator; Samuel Boadu is the recorded operational owner
staffDuplicateCheck.trigger: Customer reports an uncertain submission, or a request appears to repeat after a session/tab change
compare: Same contact, using authorized staff access to existing saved requests
Same product and variant lines and quantities
Same day and reported attempt time, with timezone recorded in the operational case where appropriate
staffDuplicateCheck.action: Check for the earlier persisted request before issuing a second invoice or advancing duplicate fulfillment. Resolve uncertain matches through the existing support/order workflow. This is a staff comparison, not a new automated merge or deletion rule.
staffDuplicateCheck.privacy: Do not copy customer contact details, raw payment evidence, private credentials or case contents into repository evidence. This record contains procedures only.

serverLimit: This client correction does not fix the server's drift-before-replay ordering. A changed catalog or agreement can still produce a refusal before the server returns a stored replay. Stable client identity is necessary but is not proof of successful replay under changed server state.
paymentBoundary: A saved request, reference or customer payment report is not verification of received funds. The QL-12 payment hold stays in force. Invoicing, authorized independent payment verification and fulfillment eligibility remain separate controls.
releaseEvidence: This disclosure satisfies an operating-record deliverable only. It is not proof that the successor passed tests, that a request was durably saved exactly once, that an operator read it, or that anything was deployed.
